# ADR <number>: <decision>

Status: Proposed
Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Owner: <responsible team>
Last verified: Not yet verified

## Context

Describe actual needs, constraints and evidence. Separate measured behavior from assumptions.

## Decision

State the chosen approach, scope and whether implementation exists. An accepted choice is not deployment evidence.

## Alternatives

Record real evaluated options and reasons. If historical evaluation is unknown, say so instead of inventing it.

## Consequences

Explain benefits, operating costs, compatibility obligations, failure behavior and reversal limits.

## Revisit when

Name concrete conditions that would justify another decision. Supersede with a new numbered record and link both directions.

## References

Link current source/configuration, supporting designs and any verified official documentation.
